strongest_angle: Break down the newly published findings from the Max Planck Institute on how mechanical forces, matrix alignment, and physical processes directly govern muscle development and strength formation.

key_facts.fact: The Max Planck Institute published research on October 16, 2026, detailing how mechanical processes regulate muscle development and structural strength.
Research published via idw-online on October 16, 2026, from the Max Planck Institute explores the force behind human strength and mechanical regulation of muscle.
Max Planck scientists including M. Weitkunat, A. Kaya-Çopur, S.W. Grill, and F. Schnorrer discovered on March 14, 2014, that tension triggers muscle building through sarcomere formation.
